scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.dev: npm run dev --prefix backend & npm run dev --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck:api
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix backend run test:coverage && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
